metadata.label: Customer Support Agent
metadata.description: Answers customer questions, looks up order and account details, and escalates to a human when it cannot resolve the request.

metadata.label: Order Tracking Agent
metadata.description: Resolves order status, delivery estimates and returns against your order management system.

metadata.label: IT Helpdesk Agent
metadata.description: Triages IT tickets, walks users through common fixes, and raises a ticket when the issue needs an engineer.

metadata.label: Document Q&A Agent
metadata.description: Answers questions over your indexed documents with citations back to the source passage.

metadata.label: Sales Lead Qualifier
metadata.description: Scores inbound leads against your qualification criteria and writes the result back to the CRM.

metadata.label: Invoice Processing Agent
metadata.description: Extracts line items and totals from incoming invoices, validates them against purchase orders, and flags mismatches.

metadata.label: HR Onboarding Agent
metadata.description: Guides new hires through onboarding tasks, answers policy questions, and tracks outstanding paperwork.

metadata.label: Meeting Scheduler Agent
metadata.description: Finds a slot that works for every attendee, books the meeting, and sends the invitations.

metadata.label: Inventory Restock Agent
metadata.description: Watches stock levels across warehouses, forecasts shortfalls, and raises purchase orders with the right supplier.

metadata.label: Contract Review Agent
metadata.description: Reads incoming contracts, surfaces clauses that deviate from your standard terms, and summarises the risk for legal.
